fact: Togo First, 18 November 2025, recalls that in December 2024 Togo launched two public data dissemination platforms, Open Data and the Geoportail Open Data, run by the Agence Togo Digital; it does not tie them to an open data policy.

La Voix de la Nation reports that the Open Data portal (opendata.gouv.tg) and the Geoportail (geodata.gouv.tg) were officially launched in December 2024 by the digital ministry through its operational arm, the Agence Togo Digital; the article names no open data policy.

The article states the Geoportail centralises data from 23 ministries and more than 550 administrative units, drawn from a 2021-2022 collection under the PRISE project; the article is dated 2025-01-08 and gives no date for the figure, so that date is used.

A post on opendata.gouv.tg dated 18 December 2024 announces the official launch ceremony on 19 December 2024 of the Open Data and Geoportail Open Data platforms giving access to data on Togo's socio-economic infrastructure; the post carries the MENTD and ATD hashtags but names no policy and no publishing bodies or dataset counts.
